insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 89.5% to ₹1,402 Cr, with gross margin of 30.8%, EBITDA of ₹208 Cr (14.8%) and adjusted PAT of ₹142 Cr; the cash conversion cycle improved to 64 days and debt/equity is 0.07. Management kept the 14-15% EBITDA guidance for FY27 and said prices have risen 10-20% so far, with about 25% expected for the year. The housing plant moved to Q3 and the cable JV to the end of FY27, while new Pro, home IoT and drone-camera lines are being developed.

what_changed.text: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 14-15% kept; Q1 at 14.8%
Housing plant now Q3 FY27 (was Phase 1 in Q2); cable JV by end FY27 (was Q2-Q3)
New categories: CP PLUS Pro, home IoT (doorbells, locks), machine vision and drone gimbal cameras
New Noida corporate office and R&D centre; Bengaluru R&D to open

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: we'll continue to deliver results that beat the expectations.

analyst_questions.answer: 10-20% so far across products, passed on monthly to avoid a demand shock; no visible hit to demand yet.
40+ brands are now certified; CP PLUS relies on brand, distribution, manufacturing scale and R&D.
About 35% of the bill of materials is semiconductors from Taiwan; aim for 40% domestic content within two quarters.
2.5 million units a month at 85-90% utilisation; doubling over three years via Kadapa and Greater Noida.

red_flags.text: Market share quoted as 43.3% for FY26 (Frost & Sullivan) after 'about 45.4%' on the May call.
Competition is rising: 40+ certified brands now.
Much of the growth is price: 10-20% hikes so far as memory and chip costs rise.
Capacity is 85-90% used while new plants slipped by a quarter or two.

business_snapshot.what_they_make: CP PLUS video surveillance cameras, recorders and AI solutions; second brand Nexivue; 42 final-assembly and 12 SMT lines
business_snapshot.customers: Distribution channel, system integrators, enterprises and government projects
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: CP PLUS 87% of revenue; IP products 79% of CP PLUS
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: STQC-driven shift to certified Indian brands, IP and AI upgrades, enterprise and government projects
